meta.description: Unofficial fan project about Star Citizen's Origin Jumpworks: the fleet, its history, and where to acquire it in game.

footer.tagline: A fine-line tribute to the most elegant manufacturer in the persistent universe.
footer.disclaimer: This is an unofficial Star Citizen Fan Site, made by a fan, not affiliated with Cloud Imperium Games.
footer.author: Made by <link>{name}</link>

home.metaTitle: Origin Jumpworks — elegance as a trajectory

hero.title: Origin Jumpworks
hero.lead: From New Austin, Origin designs ships the way one crafts an exceptional object: few lines, none to spare.
hero.imageAlt: The 890 Jump, Origin's flagship yacht, isometric view

manifesto.label: 01 — Manifesto
manifesto.quote: Owning an Origin is not a purchase. It is a lifestyle.
manifesto.body: At Origin, engineering steps back behind the line. The company is said to pay considerable bonuses to anyone who can remove a single bolt from one of its designs. The result is recognisable at first glance: continuous surfaces, light that glides, and the rare feeling that nothing was left to chance.

founding.title: The banks of the Rhine
founding.text: Founded in Cologne, the company first builds high-end fusion engines, for the UEE military as well as for RSI and Aegis star yachts.

rise.title: From supplier to competitor
rise.text: Origin designs its own ships. Within a decade, one of them enters the top five sellers of its class.

lines.title: The 200 and 300 lines
lines.text: The brand's first personal ships. Origin has held second place in that market ever since.

terra.title: Bound for Terra
terra.text: President Jennifer Friskers moves the headquarters and design team to New Austin. All that remains near Earth is an engine test facility on the Moon.

today.title: An Origin town
today.text: New Austin lives to the brand's rhythm. Buyers travel across the galaxy to take delivery of their ship straight off the factory floor.

personal.name: Personal
personal.text: The 100 and 300 series: the way into the Origin world, from the understated two-seater to the luxury fighter.

touring.name: Grand touring
touring.text: The 400i and 600i: long-range exploration and cruising, with the comfort of a residence.

racing.name: Racing
racing.text: The 350r, M50 and M80: pure speed, in the lineage of the ship with the most Carrington wins.

prestige.name: Prestige
prestige.text: The 890 Jump and its tender, the 85X: the pinnacle of the house, a yacht and its shuttle.

gravlev.name: Gravlev
gravlev.text: The X1 family: anti-gravity bikes, skimming the ground, for those who prefer to feel the speed.

flagship.label: 04 — Flagship
flagship.title: 890 Jump
flagship.lead: Two hundred and ten metres of continuous lines, an atrium, a pool, suites for some twenty guests. The 890 Jump is not built to get quickly from one point to another: it is built so that the journey becomes the destination.
flagship.imageAlt: The 890 Jump flying above the clouds

scale.label: 05 — Scale
scale.title: From the X1 to the 890 Jump
scale.lead: The whole fleet, at the same scale. The smallest fits under the wing of the largest.
scale.region: Side silhouettes of the fleet, to scale

acquire.label: 06 — Acquire
acquire.title: Where to acquire them
acquire.lead: Three dealerships in the Stanton system sell or rent the Origin fleet. Prices in aUEC, the in-game currency.
acquire.dateLine: Prices reported by the community (UEX) up to {date}, patch {version}. They change with every game update.
acquire.map: Schematic map of the Stanton system

outro.title: The thread closes
outro.lead: Every ship has its own page, images and specifications.

design.metaDescription: Tokens, typography and components of the Origin Jumpworks site.
design.title: Line first
design.lead: One-pixel lines, plenty of space, slow motion. Every element starts as an outline, then the material appears.

colors.title: Colours
colors.intro: Two themes, the same restraint. Every text colour exceeds 4.5:1; the glow and lines are reserved for decoration. These ratios are checked by an automated test.
colors.caption: Text colour contrast, {theme} theme

type.title: Typography
type.intro: Geometric, light-weight headings with wide tracking. Body text in Inter for legibility, technical codes in JetBrains Mono.
type.sampleMd: Founded in 2747, based in New Austin since 2913
type.sampleLead: Origin Jumpworks designs ships the way one designs a luxury object: clean lines, noble materials, and elegance as a primary function.
type.sampleBody: Body text stays at regular weight, with 1.6 line height and lines capped at 65 characters, for comfortable reading in both themes.

components.title: Components
components.intro: 45° cut corners, one-pixel outlines, no bounce. Outlines are drawn with clipped layers so the focus ring is never cut off.
components.linkSentence: An internal link to the <internal>home page</internal> and an external link to <external>starcitizen.tools</external>.
components.frameText: One-pixel outline, cut corners, optional corner marks.

example.title: In context
example.intro: Image from the data harvest (AVIF then WebP, blurred preview while loading) and a spec sheet with static values.

motion.title: Motion
motion.intro: Slow, eased, never jerky. Only one thing moves strongly at a time. Everything is disabled when the visitor asks for less motion.
